page_title: NAP 2-1 JUV | Napoli v Juventus 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90+2' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico La Penna saw the whole situation.
90+2' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Jonathan David (Juventus) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
86' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Noa Lang will be replaced by Antonio Vergara (Napoli).
83' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:1.
83' Juventus hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) for Khephren Thuram.
79' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Matteo Politano (Napoli) replaces David Neres.
78' 2 - 1 Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 2:1.
76' It is time for a substitution. Lois Openda (Juventus) is on for Kenan Yildiz.
75' That's the end of the game for Francisco Conceicao, who is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
74' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
71' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Filip Kostic (Juventus) replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
70' Sam Beukema (Napoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
70' Substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) has come on for Mathias Olivera.
69' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Federico La Penna had a clear view and blows his whistle.
68' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
62' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
61' A cross from a corner kick by Napoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

59' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). Weston McKennie plays a fantastic through ball and finds Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
55' What a chance to score from the free kick by Scott McTominay (Napoli). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.
54' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Noa Lang (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the top of the net is smartly dealt with by Michele Di Gregorio.
46' Substitution. Juan Cabal will be replaced by Jonathan David (Juventus).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sees his header crash off the left post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
45+1' The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' David Neres (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Federico La Penna no option but to blow his whistle.
43' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
42' Some neat passing and movement from Napoli as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
40' David Neres (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
39' Noa Lang (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
37' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
35' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece. Napoli are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
35' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
33' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
32' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
31' Kenan Yildiz picks out Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
30' A pass by David Neres (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' Some patient build-up play from Napoli as they look to unlock the defence.
27' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and it's Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' David Neres (Napoli) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
26' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Michele Di Gregorio produces a wonderful reflex save.
25' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pierre Kalulu (Juventus). Napoli will take a free kick.
21' A snap shot by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
17' Juan Cabal (Juventus) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
16' David Neres (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
16' David Neres (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
15' A dangerous looking corner kick from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence. Napoli have a corner.
15' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
14' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
11' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
10' The Juventus players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' 1 - 0 Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom left corner.
6' David Neres swings the cross over. Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
6' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

6' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
3' A pass by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' A spell of possession for Napoli in an attempt to control the game.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna will supervise the game today.
